verdict.rationale: Pendo documents some non-UI programmatic surfaces that could be scripted from automation. Track Events can be sent as REST API calls, an API endpoint bulk-deletes accounts and visitors, and Data Sync exports data to cloud storage without engineering work. There is no evidence of a CLI, a headless mode, CI integration guidance, or a published API spec (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404). missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD usage, OpenAPI spec, broad API coverage of product functions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
